statements.text: An embodied self-model is at once a body map and a cybernetic control hierarchy, made of action and perception cycles grounded in skeletal muscle. ESMs scaffold attention, imagination and action, sit in richly connected mid-level nodes, and are proposed to form communication backbones for global workspaces.

sources.quote: ESMs are both body maps and cybernetic control hierarchies, constituted by action-perception cycles grounded in skeletal muscle and associated perceptual efferents
